claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 408 seconds, from 22:31:15 to 22:38:03, which is well past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip. The dwell requirement of POL-NS-01(c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's evidence, and the rider cannot defeat the fee on a shortfall argument.

The rider's own device track is the decisive fact against her. Across the whole waiting window the rider's fixes sit between 851 m and 858 m from the pickup pin, with a mean of 854.6 m, and not one of her 70 fixes qualifies inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone. She was not at the pickup point while the driver waited there.

The rider never sent a single locating or coordinating message. The chat log holds exactly one message, sent by the DRIVER at 22:31:35 - 'im at the pickup point' - and it was read by the rider at 22:32:05. POL-NS-04 requires the rider to have sent a locating message during the waiting window; she sent none, so the rider-exonerating route of POL-NS-04 limb (a) is not available to her.

The driver's arrival marker is not false. He tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:31:15, and the trace shows him stationary at the pin from that same timestamp, with a minimum distance of 0.11 m and a speed of 0.0 kph in the dwell. There is no expressway motion and no distance over 300 m at the marker, so POL-NS-05 does not void the waiting clock.

The trip record confirms the driver's account end to end: driver assigned at 22:22:34, arrived at 22:31:15, the free waiting timer started at 22:31:17, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:38:07 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. That is 6 minutes 50 seconds of waiting against a 180 second free period, and the reason code is one of the three POL-NS-01(d) recognises.

The fare ledger is clean and reconciles. The cancellation fee line is SGD 4.50, which matches the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip, and the payment status is CHARGED with no refund issued. There is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect for the rider to exploit.

The driver's payout is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, which is SGD 3.60, and the anti-farming check does not bite: his no_show_terminations_30d is 4, but 4 divided by 40 completed_trips_30d is 0.10, which is above the 0.08 rate - so I must be candid that the rate limb is met and the count limb is met, and the compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09. I do not overstate this: the arithmetic on the record trips the guard.

The rider's profile offers her no route out either. Her no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and her disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire against her - but equally, nothing in her profile establishes that she was at the pickup point, and her lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1 is context only and may not ground any finding under POL-GEN-01.

The missing traffic advisory does not help the rider. EV-ADVIS-02751-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. There is only one interval here anyway, so the limb is unavailable and the 408 second dwell stands unmodified.

The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the STANDARD-zone arrival radius of 50 m for a continuous qualifying run of 408 seconds, from 22:31:15 to 22:38:03, with 42 qualifying fixes. That is well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 22:38:07 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and it falls after the required dwell elapsed at 22:34:15. No boarding event is recorded. Limb (d) is therefore satisfied.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the driver's trace shows a stationary fix at the arrival timestamp (distinct speed 0.0 kph) and the derived arrival block places him inside the geofence, not more than 300 m away and not travelling at or above 15 kph. The waiting clock therefore runs from the arrival event as recorded, and the corrected dwell is the same 408 seconds.

The rider's own device track places her roughly 851 to 858 m from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with 70 fixes and zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius. She was not at the pickup point, which corroborates the driver's account that the rider did not show.

The driver sent an in-app message at 22:31:35 stating 'im at the pickup point', delivered at 22:31:36 and read by the rider at 22:32:05. The driver made contact and the rider read it; the rider sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her.

The fare breakdown shows a cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged and payment_status CHARGED, with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the fee stands as charged.

The driver is entitled to compensation at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force, SGD 3.60 of SGD 4.50, under POL-NS-07. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 4, which meets the absolute limb, but 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08 - so the check DOES trip and compensation is withheld, escalating under POL-NS-09. I concede this point: the driver's own profile shows the pattern POL-NS-07 guards against.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals can be claimed. This does not help the driver, but it also does not defeat the fee, because the single continuous 408-second run already exceeds the 180-second minimum without any accumulation.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged on the rider side. The escalation here is driven solely by the driver's own anti-farming profile, not by any rider abuse pattern.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the events, and the arrival and waiting conditions do check out - this case turns on a platform anti-farming guard, not on any dispute about the pickup, so the outcome is that the SGD 4.50 stays on hold until a person looks at it.

ARRIVAL AND WAITING (POL-NS-01). The trip record EV-TRIP-02751 shows a driver 'arrived' event at 22:31:15, and the GPS trace EV-GPS-02751 places the driver inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius from that same timestamp - limbs (a) and (b) hold. The trace shows one continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 408 seconds (22:31:15 to 22:38:03, 42 fixes), which is well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) - limb (c) holds. The trip was terminated by the driver at 22:38:07 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed at 22:34:15, with no boarding event - limb (d) holds. The fee is therefore chargeable under POL-NS-01 at SGD 4.50, and the fare ledger EV-FARE-02751 reconciles with the platform figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

WHY NO OTHER CLAUSE DISPLACES THE FEE. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply - the driver was inside the 50 m radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message; the only chat message, MSG-02751-001, is the driver's 'im at the pickup point'. POL-NS-05 does not fire - at 22:31:15 the driver was stationary at the pin (minimum distance 0.11 m, speed 0 kph), so the arrival marker is not false. POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall. The rider's own track (EV-GPS-02751, roughly 851-858 m from the pin) is not needed to decide the fee and does not change the result.

DRIVER PAYMENT AND THE ESCALATION. POL-NS-07 would pay the driver 80% of SGD 4.50, i.e. SGD 3.60. That payout is withheld: the anti-farming check trips on the driver's own profile EV-DPROF-02751, where no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the threshold is 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 equals 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Both limbs are met, so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). The escalation is terminal: no money moves automatically, and the SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether the driver's pattern - 4 no-show terminations in 30 days at a 0.10 rate against 40 completed trips - is fee-farming or ordinary volume. Under POL-NS-07, if it is not accepted the reviewer is directed to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 in full.

EVIDENCE AND DISCARDED CLAIMS. Two claims resting on the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02751-01 (weight 0.0) were discarded for not naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code (POL-GEN-02(1)); the advisory is absent in any event, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable and the single 408-second run already exceeds the minimum without it. The reference to rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags was flagged as a context-only field under POL-GEN-01; it is correctly not used as a ground of decision and grounds nothing here.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact that carries a deciding fact - EV-TRIP-02751, EV-GPS-02751, EV-DPROF-02751 and EV-FARE-02751 - has a weight of 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.
referrals: [POL-NS-07] Direct the human reviewer, on escalation under POL-NS-09, to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full; the fee is held rather than collected or refunded by the automated pipeline pending that review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The trip-level facts favour the driver, but the platform's anti-farming guard stops this case from closing automatically, so no money moves today.

What the record shows. The trip record and the GPS trace agree that the driver reached the pick-up at Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres at 22:31:15 on 15 Sep and then held position inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone arrival radius for a continuous 408 seconds, on 42 qualifying fixes (POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (c); 408 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip). He cancelled at 22:38:07 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event — 6 minutes 50 seconds of waiting. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05: at the moment he tapped 'I'm Here' the trace puts him 0.11 m from the pin and stationary (0.0 km/h), so the waiting clock is not reset. POL-NS-06 does not apply — the dwell was not short — and the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02751-01 (weight 0.0) changes nothing, because there is only one in-geofence interval to measure. The fare ledger's SGD 4.50 cancellation fee matches the SGD 4.50 in force for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

ruling.explanation:
The record here is unusually clean, and the two sides actually agree about it; the outcome turns on the driver's own profile.

WHAT HAPPENED. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02751, weight 1.0) shows the driver assigned at 22:22:34, tapped 'I'm Here' at 22:31:15, the free waiting timer started at 22:31:17, and the driver cancelled at 22:38:07 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02751, weight 1.0) places him inside the STANDARD-zone rendezvous radius of 50 m for one continuous qualifying run of 408 seconds, 22:31:15 to 22:38:03, with 42 qualifying fixes. The free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02751.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) is 180 seconds, so the dwell required by POL-NS-01(c) was met and the cancellation at 22:38:07 fell after that dwell elapsed at 22:34:15. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) all hold.

NO CLAUSE DISPLACES THE FEE. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the marker the driver was stationary at the pin (minimum distance 0.11 m; speed 0.0 kph), not more than 300 m away and not travelling at 15 kph or more, so the waiting clock is not recomputed. The dwell exceeds the minimum, so POL-NS-06's premature-cancellation route does not open. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: it needs a locating or coordinating message from the rider, and the chat log (EV-CHAT-02751, weight 1.0) holds one message, sent by the driver at 22:31:35 and read at 22:32:05. The rider's device track shows 70 fixes, none inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, sitting 851–858 m from the pin throughout — she was not at the pickup point. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02751, weight 1.0) charges SGD 4.50, which reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

WHY THIS DOES NOT BECOME A DRIVER PAYOUT. POL-NS-07 would fix the driver's compensation at 80% of SGD 4.50, i.e. SGD 3.60. But the anti-farming guard on the driver's own profile (EV-DPROF-02751, weight 1.0) trips: no_show_terminations_30d is 4 (the absolute limb requires 4 or more) and 4 divided by completed_trips_30d of 40 is 0.10, which is above the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs are met. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Both advocates conceded this point candidly, and the arithmetic is on the record.

THE CONSEQUENCE. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal: no money moves now. The disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded while a human reviewer decides. The escalation trigger is POL-NS-09(d) — the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check. The open question for the reviewer is whether this driver's four no-show terminations in 30 days reflect genuine no-shows or fee-farming; on this particular trip the no-show is real (the rider was 851–858 m away throughout), but the trailing-30-day pattern is a judgement the automated pipeline is not permitted to make, and the reviewer must also decide the refund direction POL-NS-07 writes into the packet.

ON THE CLAIMS. All surviving claims were accepted: the arrival (POL-NS-01(a)), the 408-second dwell (POL-NS-01(c), POL-NS-02), the RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code after the dwell (POL-NS-01(d)), the non-false marker (POL-NS-05), the rider's absence (POL-NS-04), the clean fare ledger (POL-NS-08), and the withheld compensation (POL-NS-07/09). They do not conflict and they lead to the escalation above. Two claims about the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02751-01, weight 0.0) were discarded by the referee for failing to name the MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code and are not relied on; nothing in this ruling turns on that artifact, whose absence only made POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, which is irrelevant because no accumulation was needed. The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was used for no finding.

The rider's own device track places her 851–858 m from the pin throughout, with zero of her 70 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and she sent no locating or coordinating message — so neither POL-NS-04 (unanswered contact) nor POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) exonerates her, and POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m arrival radius, not merely within 400 m of the pin. The fare breakdown reconciles to the fee in force: SGD 4.50 charged, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver's pattern — 4 no-show terminations in 30 days at a 0.10 rate — is systemic fee-farming warranting account review, and to confirm the rider's full refund of SGD 4.50 before release.
